items.question: How do I book a cab in Patna or Bihar Sharif with Bihar Cab Service?
items.answer:
You can book instantly by calling our 24x7 phone hotline or by submitting your
                                        pickup & drop details in our instant WhatsApp booking form. We confirm your booking within 30 minutes.

items.question: What is the fixed taxi fare from Patna JPNI Airport to Bihar Sharif?
items.answer:
Our fixed taxi fares from Patna Airport to Bihar Sharif are highly competitive
                                        and completely transparent. Please contact our support via WhatsApp or phone for
                                        the most accurate current rates with zero hidden charges.

items.question: Are toll charges and parking fees included in the fixed fare?
items.answer:
Toll charges and parking fees are typically not included in our base fare to
                                        ensure transparency. You only pay for what you use, and our drivers will provide
                                        receipts for any toll or parking expenses incurred during your trip.

items.question: Is cab service available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week?
items.answer:
Yes, BiharCabs operates 24x7. Whether it's a late-night airport pickup or an
                                        early-morning outstation drop, our support team and verified drivers are always
                                        ready to serve you.

items.question: Are drivers verified, licensed, and safe for late night rides?
items.answer:
Absolutely. Passenger safety is our topmost priority. All our drivers undergo a
                                        strict background verification process, hold valid commercial licenses, and are
                                        specially trained to ensure a safe experience for late-night commuters.

items.question: Do I need to pay any advance payment for booking confirmation?
items.answer:
For local rides, no advance payment is usually required. However, for certain
                                        outstation trips or premium vehicle bookings (like Tempo Travellers), a nominal
                                        advance may be requested to confirm your reservation.

items.question: Can I get doorstep cab pickup in Araut and Faraut villages?
items.answer:
Yes! We proudly extend our pickup and drop-off services beyond just the city
                                        centers, offering reliable doorstep cab pickups across surrounding areas,
                                        including Araut, Faraut, and other nearby villages.
